python3 - <<'EOF'
import os, tempfile
from miniconf.loader import load
from miniconf.errors import ConfigError
c=load('examples/service.conf');print(c.get('level',section='logging'),c.get('port',section='http'))
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:
    os.mkdir(d+'/sub')
    w=lambda n,t: open(d+'/'+n,'w').write(t)
    w('a.conf','a=1\n@include sub/b.conf\n'); w('sub/b.conf','x=1\n@include ../a.conf\n'); w('m.conf','@include nope.conf\n')
    for f in ('a','m'):
        try: load(d+'/%s.conf'%f)
        except ConfigError as e: print('ConfigError',e)
EOF
